changes: Local import paths; custom map backend; StateDB HasStorage replacing storage roots; removed Verkle/witness, post-Cancun dispatch/BLS/P256, C crypto and zkVM; modified tests to use the map backend. See README. Removed log package, tracer hooks/reason arguments and preimage/event collection; LOG opcodes preserve gas/stack/static semantics and discard output; receipt Bloom generation disabled. Removed the consensus/misc/eip4844 package; Engine reads the Cancun blob budget directly from execution configuration. Whole-directory audit: removed block/account/receipt/withdrawal/deposit/log codecs, network/genesis/PoW/Clique/DAO settings, unsupported authorization and transaction-pool metadata, network blob sidecars, key/SQL/filesystem utilities and extra crypto APIs. RLP retained unchanged; fixed upstream signing/address reference vectors included. Optional AddTransactionFee adapter callback at the final transaction reward; default backends retain immediate AddBalance. Interpreter/opcodes and gas arithmetic unchanged.
local_source_scope: Local execution-only Cancun fork: interpreter, instructions, gas, minimal signed transaction/receipt types, execution fork config, custom map state and required RLP/crypto helpers.

shared_replay_adapter.scope: Optional structural interface at final fee credit; vm.StateDB unchanged.

standalone_extraction.scope: Internal Go imports renamed from statera/evm-runtime. Runtime behavior and upstream license headers retained. slim_source_sha256 records the standalone source files; upstream source hashes remain historical provenance.
